characters.name: 랴오
characters.prompt:
The attached image is a character and frame reference only. Reconstruct the INTERIOR as an EXTREMELY LOW RESOLUTION hand-designed 20x20 retro game ICON, enlarged to fit the frame. Intentional flat colored square clusters, not an automatic mosaic. THIS IS AN ABSTRACTION EXPERIMENT: sacrificing face details is REQUIRED. It is acceptable to omit the eyes, nose, mouth, earrings and plant details where the tiny grid cannot carry them. DO NOT preserve detailed facial anatomy. No tiny pixel fragments or fine contours inside.
Treat the whole inner image as just 20 columns by 20 rows of HUGE square color units. Only about 400 such squares in the entire interior. The FACE is 5-6 squares wide and 6 squares tall. A 1-square step should occupy about one TWENTIETH of the inner canvas width. Facial features are only one or two giant solid square blocks. No eyelash, highlights in pupils, nostrils or individual strands.
Use ONLY 8 to 12 flat colors within the frame. Hard square staircase edges. No gradients, no painted texture, no small shading subpixels, no dithering. The subject remains an adult upper-chest bust facing right with the same placement. Ivory inner background.
IDENTIFY HIM using a single dark spiky hair mass with a few square spikes, red horizontal headband, cream horizontal blindfold, one orange/tan cheek-and-jaw shape facing right, yellow/ochre shoulders and a dark brown V collar. Grass may be reduced to a short green line of large squares, no seed details. No eyes through the blindfold.
VERY IMPORTANT: the GOLD FRAME is NOT part of the low-resolution icon. Keep the reference frame at high original detail: thin double golden lines, finely beveled square corner jewels, delicate highlights, dark brown outer margin, all corners visible. It should be the same sharp detailed gold physical frame containing an absurdly coarse tiny icon. Frame can have fine details while the icon absolutely cannot.
Deliver ONE square high-resolution PNG canvas around1254px, no text or visible grid lines. The subject itself must be recognizably MUCH coarser than a standard 32x32 game portrait.
characters.visualReview: Viewed individually. Clearly coarser than prior32 reference; 128 target is more abstract than64. Fine high-resolution frame style retained. Exact grid size and exact frame pixels not guaranteed.
